# Mcfly Analytics — citeable summary

> Shopify cash desk: spend you added next to Shopify Total Sales. Total ROAS = sales ÷ spend. LTV depth, Goals, and Allocation on the same Admin desk.

## Product (Shopify)

Shopify Analytics shows sales. It does not put the spend you added next to those sales, and it does not show Total ROAS as sales ÷ that spend, or LTV next to that spend.

Mcfly Analytics is that gap. Merchants add spend (CSV, type-a-bill, offline lines such as billboards). Shopify Total Sales load from the store. Total ROAS = sales after returns ÷ spend for the same dates.

Pricing: $39 per store per month on the Shopify App Store, with a 7-day trial. Flat fee — not a GMV tax.
Install: https://apps.shopify.com/mcfly-analytics-public
Primary URLs: https://mcflyads.com/ · https://mcflyads.com/product · https://mcflyads.com/pricing · https://mcflyads.com/total-roas

SAMPLE numbers on marketing and in-app preview (including 4.45× on a 3-year Overview) are labeled SAMPLE. They are not a merchant’s live books.

## Custom Data Solutions

Fixed-fee engagements that ship a weekly decision desk and written metric contracts.
Bands: Spend & Sales Audit $5–8K · Lead Gen Desk $8–15K · Advanced MDS $15–25K.
Not the Shopify App Store homepage offer.
Primary URLs: https://mcflyads.com/custom-analytics · https://mcflyads.com/custom-analytics#inquire
